name: runhand
description: Agent-driven computational research workflow acceleration using trusted Simulator and Site capabilities plus a deterministic filesystem CLI.

interface.shortDescription: Accelerate recurring simulation, analysis, and HPC workflows.
interface.longDescription: Completes concise computational-research requests from local precedent while preserving action authority. It delegates simulation identity, mutation, and validation to trusted Simulator capabilities; delegates host, resources, scheduler, and scratch policy to trusted Site capabilities; and uses the RunHand CLI for bounded context scans, safe staging, atomic no-replace promotion, scratch allocation, and conservative garbage collection.
defaultPrompt: Create a new simulation run from the nearest precedent.
Run a bounded smoke test using site-safe scratch.
Analyze these runs and preserve only the durable result.
